ns2:course.label: Cultural Prod in Dictatorships
ns2:course.description: Cultural production (visual and literary) of three Latin American dictatorships: Chile (1973-1990), Uruguay (1973-1985) and Argentina (1976-1983). Provides a comparative study of narrative- both short stories and novels- and films covering the dictatorship years and the process of redemocratization. The guiding questions are: how and through which means can a traumatic past be represented? Do texts and films share topics and strategies to depict authoritarianism? Prerequisite: LAST 170 or consent of instructor.
